name: Diameter / Projected Distinguishing Range (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, diameter is $n$ while projected distinguishing range is $1$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the n-singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, projected distinguishing range is $n-1$ while diameter is $2$.
proof: The two explicit benchmark calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Diameter and Projected Distinguishing Range of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
